# Provenance — Generic OBO Foundry Issue Templates

This file records exactly where each section of the 12 generic issue templates came from: which OBO Foundry ontology's GitHub issue-template file it was extracted or adapted from, that repository's declared license, and the specific field-by-field breakdown for each generic template.

Sections that are not explicitly defined in this file has been identified after the review of other repository issue templates as being needed. Thus, sections not explicitly defined in this file are not directly influenced by what has been present in other repositories' issue templates and such have no references.

**Note:** ontologies with an unclear or no explicit license have not been used in spite of having issue templates. Every field below is drawn only from repos with an explicit, standard open license (CC BY or CC0).

## Source repositories and licenses

| Ontology ID | Title | Repository | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agro` | Agronomy Ontology | https://github.com/AgriculturalSemantics/agro | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `cl` | Cell Ontology | https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `doid` | Human Disease Ontology | https://github.com/DiseaseOntology/HumanDiseaseOntology | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |
| `fbbi` | Biological Imaging Methods Ontology | https://github.com/foundingGIDE/fbbi | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `foodon` | Food Ontology | https://github.com/FoodOntology/foodon | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `fypo` | Fission Yeast Phenotype Ontology | https://github.com/pombase/fypo | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `go` | Gene Ontology | https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `mondo` | Mondo Disease Ontology | https://github.com/monarch-initiative/mondo | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `ms` | Mass spectrometry ontology | https://github.com/HUPO-PSI/psi-ms-CV | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `omo` | OBO Metadata Ontology | https://github.com/information-artifact-ontology/ontology-metadata | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |
| `pbpko` | Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetic Ontology | https://github.com/InSilicoVida-Research-Lab/pbpko | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `so` | Sequence types and features ontology | https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| `uberon` | Uberon multi-species anatomy ontology | https://github.com/obophenotype/uberon | [CC BY 3.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) |

Note: this license is the licenses identified in the GitHub Repositories. Since we are using the issue templates as inspiration we will consider the licenses of the ontologies' GitHub ropositories rather than the license of the ontology it self.
